# Caruso Martech

> Caruso Martech is a marketing consultancy that builds marketing systems and growth strategy for founder-led and scale-up businesses. We work across strategy, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics for SaaS, events, ecommerce, and professional services companies, with budgets typically in the €5,000-€30,000 range.

Key areas of work: performance marketing (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), marketing automation and CRM workflow design, SEO, attribution and measurement, and fractional CMO engagements. We favor practical, evidenced writing over generic marketing advice, with real campaign numbers and case studies wherever possible.

## Pages

- [Home](https://carusomartech.com/): Overview of Caruso Martech and what we do. Marketing systems and growth strategy for SaaS, events, ecommerce, and professional services.
- [Work](https://carusomartech.com/work): Case studies from paid media campaigns across events, B2B, coaching, and recreation verticals, with measurable ROAS and lead generation results.
- [Services](https://carusomartech.com/services): Services covering growth strategy, paid media, SEO, marketing automation, and analytics. Retainer and project engagements available.
- [About](https://carusomartech.com/about): The thinking behind Caruso Martech and the approach to fixing broken marketing systems across industries.
- [Insights](https://carusomartech.com/insights): Practical articles on marketing leadership, system design, attribution, and automation.
- [Contact](https://carusomartech.com/contact): How to get in touch to discuss a marketing challenge or book a call.

- [Self-Adjusting Campaigns: What Marketing Automation Looks Like Beyond the Schedule](https://carusomartech.com/insights/self-adjusting-campaign-automation): Most small teams still run automation on a calendar. Here is what it takes to move from scheduled sends to campaigns that adjust to real behavior, and when that shift is actually worth making.
- [Marketing Mix Modeling Is Back: What It Takes for a Small Team](https://carusomartech.com/insights/marketing-mix-modeling-small-teams): Marketing mix modeling used to require a data science team and a six-figure budget. Free open-source tools and the collapse of cookie-based tracking changed that math for small teams.
- [Why Your Campaign Calendar Keeps Outrunning Creative Production](https://carusomartech.com/insights/campaign-calendar-creative-bottleneck): Most calendars plan around launch dates while ignoring production capacity. Here's why that gap causes missed launches, and how to build a calendar that reflects what your team can actually ship.
- [AI Citations vs. AI Mentions: Why the Difference Decides Whether You Get Chosen](https://carusomartech.com/insights/ai-citations-vs-mentions): Being named by ChatGPT and being linked as a source are two different signals, and most brands only earn one. Here is what separates them and how to close the gap.
- [How to Build an AI Content Workflow Without Losing Quality Control](https://carusomartech.com/insights/ai-content-workflow-quality-control): A practical checkpoint system for AI-assisted content: where AI speeds up production, where human review can't be skipped, and how to catch problems before they publish.
- [How to Track Your Visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews](https://carusomartech.com/insights/tracking-ai-search-visibility): What marketing teams can and can't measure when tracking brand visibility in AI search, and which tools are actually worth paying for in 2026.

- [How to Read a GA4 Attribution Report Without Getting Misled](https://carusomartech.com/insights/ga4-attribution-report-guide): GA4 quietly recalibrated its default attribution model in 2026, and the report can look precise while hiding a fallback to last-click. Here's how to read it correctly.
- [Server-Side Tracking for Small Teams: What It Actually Requires](https://carusomartech.com/insights/server-side-tracking-small-teams): Server-side tracking recovers real conversion data lost to ad blockers and Safari's cookie limits, but it takes real infrastructure to set up. Here is what it actually requires, what it costs, and when to wait.
- [How to Brief a Marketing Agency So the Work Actually Lands](https://carusomartech.com/insights/agency-brief-template): A vague brief gets an agency guessing, and guesses cost money. Here is what separates a brief that produces strong creative and media work from one you end up rewriting.

- [The Difference Between Attribution and Measurement (And Why It Matters)](https://carusomartech.com/insights/attribution-vs-measurement): Attribution tracks which touchpoint got the credit. Measurement tells you what actually drove revenue. Confusing the two leads teams to defend channels that aren't working and cut ones that are.
